plan: To maximize profit, bid slightly above the average expected bid. With values ranging from $0 to $49, the average value is $24.5. Bidding slightly above my value of $20, say $20.1, ensures I only win if others bid below $20.1, minimizing loss risk. This conservative bid is optimal given the single round constraint.

To maximize profit, bid slightly above half of my value to cover potential bids from Andy and Charles. Given a value of $29, bid $15 to ensure a positive outcome even if I win, as the worst-case payout would be $14.9. This strategy balances winning chances and maintaining profit, considering the independent value draws for opponents.

Given my value is $45, I aim to bid slightly below this to maximize profit while ensuring a win. Bidding exactly my value risks zero profit if I win. A bid of $44.9 offers a balance by undercutting my value slightly, increasing profit if I win and pay a lower second-highest bid. This strategy minimizes loss in worst-case scenarios where competitors bid closely to my value.
